feeding_claim.verbatim: Grass-fed beef is solely fed pasture grasses and hay

resold_note: Also sells pasture-raised chicken from Middlefork Meadows in Rossville, Indiana.
notes: Not the same farm as holy-cow-beef (Lubbock, TX); this one is a farm and on-farm butcher shop north of Monon, Indiana. Checked the farm store, our farm, grass-fed beef, grain-finished beef, pork, chicken and lamb pages; the bulk meat page would not load. The farm sells two beef lines: grass-fed beef fed only pasture and hay, and grain-finished beef fed the farm's own non-GMO corn for the last 3 to 6 months, so the category is both. Pigs get pasture plus the farm's own non-GMO feed mix and lamb is described as 100% grass-fed. Beef, pork and lamb are sold by the cut and in bulk, with custom bulk orders through the on-farm butcher. Orders are picked up at the farm store or shipped within Indiana only (free on $150 or more, not for bulk). Pricing was being updated when checked, and the store hours shown in the header and footer differ.
